verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official open-source CLI (github.com/ramp-public/ramp-cli) with agent-first design: --agent JSON output, --no-input for CI, OAuth client-credentials login for standalone agents, agent profiles, and a full resource surface (bills, cards, funds, transactions, etc.), plus packaged agentic-purchase skills tied to Agent Cards. This is corroborated by a live probe confirming the public repo. missing for 10: no independent third-party review or adoption evidence beyond Ramp's own docs/repo.
